title: Case Converter | Uppercase, Lowercase, Title and Sentence Case
description: Convert English text to uppercase, lowercase, title case, or sentence case in one click.
intro:
Change the capitalization of English titles and sentences. Title case capitalizes the first letter of each word. Sentence case capitalizes only the first letter.

Korean text has no letter case, so it is left as it is.
howTo: Paste your text into the input box.
Copy the result from the output box.

faq.q: Does title case skip small words like 'of' or 'the'?
faq.a: No. Every word gets a capital first letter. Exception rules are not applied.
